title: Director of Production Operations
text:
**Director of Production Operations**

Owen Daniels is proud to partner with a provider of advanced maritime technology, specializing in autonomous and uncrewed surface vessels for defense and commercial applications. They are an established global business, expanding operations to Virginia Beach.

As part of this expansion, they are looking for an experienced Manufacturing Operations leader to report to the CEO and deliver the company’s US production strategy.

**Summary**

This role leads US production operations and supply chain, delivering advanced maritime technology to the US Department of War. You will own final assembly and test in Virginia Beach, along with nationwide responsibility for any manufacturing operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Execute the company’s US manufacturing strategy across both production sites.
* Lead final assembly, test and manufacturing operations in Virginia Beach.
* Hold full responsibility for all production sites, including performance, people and compliance.
* Manage the local supply chain, including supplier selection, performance and material availability.
* Own the Quality Management System and drive quality performance across both sites.
* Deliver production to cost, schedule, technical, quality and security requirements.
* Develop the production operating plan and manage the approved budget.
* Build and lead production, supply chain and quality teams as operations scale.
* Ensure compliance with NISPOM, ITAR/EAR, Technology Control Plans and export control requirements.
* Support security measures within production, working with the Facility Security Officer.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor’s Degree, ideally Master’s, with 8 years’ relevant experience.
* Proven leadership of manufacturing or final assembly operations, ideally across multiple sites.
* Experience managing supply chain and Quality Management Systems.
* Understanding of Defense or Maritime operations

**Further Details & Benefits**

* Virginia Beach based, with travel to other facilities
* Competitive salary and benefits.

**Salary:**
$160,000 – $200,000
